tha-ap472:1.1: ajjhogāhetvā → ajjhogahetvā (bj, pts) | ajjhogāhetvā himavaṁ → ajjhogahetvā himavantaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap472:2.2: chaḷaṅge pāramiṁ gatā sakavijjāhupatthaddhā → chalaṅge pāramiṅgatā sakavijjāh upatthaddhā (pts)
tha-ap472:4.2: dasasahassi kampatha → dasasahassī pakampatha (bj, pts) | pakampatha → kampatha (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap472:5.4: ubbijjiṁsu → vimhayiṁsu (sya-all) | ubbijjiṁsu → vimhayiṁsu (bj: syā) | ubbijjiṁsu → vimhayiṁsu (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap472:7.1: avacāsiṁ → avavāsiṁ (bj); vidassāmi (sya-all) | avavāsiṁ → vidassāmi (bj: syā) | Avacāsiṁ → vidassāmi (cck: syā.)
tha-ap472:7.2: bhetha → bhāyittha (sya-all) | bhetha → mābhāyittha (bj: syā) | bhetha → mā roda (cck: ka.); mābhāyittha (cck: syā.)
tha-ap472:7.4: suvatthiko → sukhatthiko (sya-all) | suvatthiko → sukhatthiko (bj: syā) | suvatthiko → sukhatthiko (cck: syā.)
tha-ap472:8.1: samphussa → samphassā (sya-all) | samphussa → aṭṭhahetūhi samphassa (cck: syā. pī.); atthahetu nisaṁsayaṁ (cck: ka.)
tha-ap472:9.4: pañca sīle kathesahaṁ → pañcasīle kathem ahaṁ (pts)
tha-ap472:17.1: sattacattālīsamo tassuddānaṁ → sattacattāḷīsamo uddānaṁ (bj) | sālakusumiyavaggo → sālapupphiyamaggo (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap472:19.4: avaṭalabujappado pilakkhapaṭibhānī → avaṇṭa labujappado pilakkhapaṭibhāṇi (bj); avaṭaṁlabujappado pilakkhu paṭibhānī (pts)
tha-ap472:20.2: dijo → dijā (sya-all) | veyyākaraṇiyo → veyyakaraṇako (pts) | veyyākaraṇiyo → veyyākaraṇako (bj: sīmu)
